mechanics.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage, and one of the following effects occurs, determined by the kind of dragon that created the creature:
The creature can teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it.
The creature gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
The target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the next attack roll it makes before the start of the creature's next turn.
The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pushed horizontally up to 10 feet away from the creature and be knocked prone.
The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn.
